```{ojs}
//| label: fig-normal-map
//| fig-cap: A Normal posterior density $\pi(\theta\mid\underline{x})$ with its MAP estimate indicated by the vertical line at the mode. For a Normal posterior, the MAP coincides with the mean. In this case, the MAP estimate is $\hat{\theta} = 1$.
//| fig-align: center
//| echo: false

// Parameters for the (posterior) Normal distribution
mu_post = 1        // posterior mean (and MAP)
sigma_post = 0.4   // posterior standard deviation

// Grid over the real line (about ±3σ around the mean)
normalXs = d3.range(mu_post - 3 * sigma_post, mu_post + 3 * sigma_post, (6 * sigma_post) / 200)



// Data for plotting
posteriorNormal = normalXs.map(x => ({ x, y: normalPDF(x, mu_post, sigma_post) }))

// MAP point (mode of the posterior)
mapPoint = ({ x: mu_post, y: normalPDF(mu_post, mu_post, sigma_post) })

Plot.plot({
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 48,
  marginBottom: 45,
  x: { label: "θ", nice: true },
  y: { label: "Posterior density" },
  style: {
    width: "100%",
    display: "block",
    margin: "0 auto",
    maxWidth: "960px",
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 14
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
    Plot.lineY(posteriorNormal, { 
      x: "x", 
      y: "y", 
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2 
    }),
    Plot.areaY(posteriorNormal, { 
      x: "x", 
      y: "y", 
      fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      fillOpacity: 0.15 
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([mapPoint.x], { 
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2, 
      strokeDasharray: "4,2" 
    }),
    Plot.text(
      [{ x: mapPoint.x, y: mapPoint.y, label: "MAP" }],
      { 
        x: "x", 
        y: "y", 
        text: "label", 
        dy: -10, 
        fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        fontWeight: "bold" 
      }
    )
  ]
})
```
